Watch the title song "Anjaana Anjaani" from the Bollywood movie starring Ranbir Kapoor and Priyanka Chopra. The song is sung by Monali Thakur & Nikhil D'Souza and the music is composed by Vishal Dadlani, Shekhar Ravjiani.
Song - Anjaana Anjaani
Film - Anjaana Anjaani
Singer - Monali Thakur & Nikhil D'Souza
Lyricist - Irshad Kamil, Kausar Munir
Music Director - Vishal Dadlani, Shekhar Ravjiani
Artist - Priyanka Chopra, Ranbir Kapoor
Music On - T-Series
